_meta.reading: A cause code is a refusal, park or escalation by a defense. Each entry names the risk, technique or weakness whose condition the refusal answers. It does not claim the cause detects that attack, only that the structural condition it refuses is the one the entry describes. Where no entry fits the entry says none and why. Internal routing, state and integrity causes are not forced onto a taxonomy.

kinds.security-control: the cause refuses or escalates a condition an attacker or a faulty agent would produce
kinds.routing: an intended routing outcome or a refusal of a malformed reading, not itself a security risk
kinds.internal: a malformed input, completeness or state transition refusal inside the stack
